definitions.explanation: The process of transmitting electrical power from generating stations to distribution systems and end users, typically through high-voltage power lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{送電|そうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Power transmission was stopped by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発電所|はつでんしょ}→発電所：15991_hatsudensho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{送|おく}られる→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Electricity is sent from power plants to cities through high-voltage transmission lines.

notes:
FORMS:
{送|そう} (to send) + {電|でん} (electricity). Literally 'sending electricity.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧ (power line, transmission line)
- {送電|そうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (to stop power transmission)
- {送電|そうでん}{鉄塔|てっとう} (transmission tower, pylon)
- {送電|そうでん}⟦ロス→ロス：11223_rosu⟧ (transmission loss)
- {送電|そうでん}{網|もう} (power grid)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配電|はいでん}→配電：30069_haiden⟧: power distribution — the final stage of delivering electricity to consumers
- ⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧: power generation — producing electricity
